title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 9, section 23 (Savary Island)
heading: Savary Island
sourceText:
Schedule 9 Firearms Using Shot Only Areas (Section 10 (1) (a))
Savary Island
23 That portion of the Province of British Columbia which is contained within the following described boundary: The mean low water mark of Savary Island. [en. B.C. Reg. 205/94, s. 30.]
